visual.title: The exponent decides
visual.caption: At p = 2 the partial sums settle quickly toward π²/6. At p = 1 they do not settle at all, so the boundary sits exactly at one.

predict.question: Σ 1/k^p converges exactly when:
predict.explain: The integral test gives convergence for p > 1. The case p = 1 is the harmonic series, which diverges.
